messages:
maria: Ugh rain + weird window glare. Moved desk under the window but Zoom blur turns me into a floating head. Anyone have quick lighting tips? :umbrella:

jon: Try a 2-light setup — key + fill. Place a warm key at ~45° to your face, and a cooler fill behind the camera. :bulb:

devon: Also check camera exposure; auto-expose freaks out with backlight. If you have Logitech/Elgato software enable face-priority or lock exposure.

sasha: Cheap diffuser hack: clip a translucent file folder or use a clean white pillowcase over the lamp. Softens the light a ton.

maria: @jon @sasha omg the pillowcase trick worked. Less halo, still a tiny blur ghost though. Any Zoom settings I should toggle?

jon: Zoom -> Settings -> Video: enable 'Touch up my appearance' (subtle), disable 'Adjust for low light' if it's oscillating. In Backgrounds try blur level 1 before cranking to max.

sasha: If you want more control, try OBS + VirtualCam — add a Color Correction filter and tweak exposure/saturation. Quick guide:
```
OBS -> Sources -> Video Capture Device -> Filters -> Color Correction
Brightness: -0.08
Contrast: 1.05
Saturation: 0.9
```

devon: Protip: add a small back/hair light behind your monitor (a lamp pointed at the wall) to give separation. Background blur handles depth better that way.

opsbot: Reminder: Weekly townhall moved to 9am PST tomorrow. :bell:

maria: lol thanks opsbot, and thank you all! will send before/after pic tomorrow :camera_with_flash:
